title: Adjacent DBinder transaction partial-state and socket-close cleanup scan

routes_reviewed: DBinderBaseInvoker::ProcessTransaction early returns and caller-state restoration
exclusions: No inference from unpaired SoftBus source or build head.
No claim about a deployed product build absent a target manifest/build lock.
This is a narrow route scan, not a whole-tree audit.

source_binding.method: Fetched raw.githubusercontent.com file contents at immutable target commit; SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 computed from exact UTF-8 bytes.

files.source_note: Only IPC-side grant/remove accounting is in scope; no unpaired SoftBus implementation semantics inferred.

transaction_path_findings.caller_gate: ProcessTransaction calls CheckAndSetCallerInfo(listenFd, tr->cookie) before target dispatch. The active DBinder session tuple (pid/uid/token/device), cookie stub index, and socket mapping must match; local Binder INCREFS/DECREFS are rejected in the handlers.
transaction_path_findings.state_effect: INCREFS calls AttachOrUpdateAppAuthInfo with socketId=GetClientFd and stub=nullptr; DECREFS calls DetachAppAuthInfo and drops a strong ref only on successful exact tuple/index/socket removal. Close callback removes socket-bound rows under appAuthMutex_, then drops corresponding strong refs.
transaction_path_findings.error_and_rollback: INCREFS ignores the boolean return and returns ERR_NONE; the method's normal stub-null outcome is false after its map update, so this is not by itself a failed update. DECREFS is idempotent against close removal because only the successful exact-row detach decrements the reference. Close cleanup removes state before looking up stub indices and drops refs for surviving indices.
transaction_path_findings.residual_race: A transaction that passed CheckAndSetCallerInfo can race close and call INCREFS after close removed the row, potentially reinserting the tuple/socket relation. Distinct per-thread invoker locks do not prove a stable exploit schedule or user-visible effect; D29/T30/T33 classified this as unproven absent runtime overlap and last-ref proof.

transaction_path_findings.existing_tests_and_counterexamples: D29/T30/T33 already reviewed the relation/refcount paths: exact DECREFS-vs-close duplicate decrement is prevented by serialized exact-row removal; no deterministic late-reinsert schedule/impact established. No tests were run by D43.

transaction_path_findings.caller_gate: DBinderInvokeListenThread requires local Binder and calling UID < 10000 before parsing; normal app UIDs are outside this gate. Production C++ and C callers are internal DBinder lifecycle paths; upstream peer reachability is not proved here.
transaction_path_findings.state_effect: Listener is started before AddStubByIndex; after index creation, reply fields are written; app-auth mapping and strong ref are attached only after all writes succeed.
transaction_path_findings.error_and_rollback: AddStubByIndex failure or reply serialization failure after listener/index creation returns without immediate rollback. Repeated same-stub AddStubByIndex reuses the index. Ordinary caller reachability, harmful persistent state, and backend listener behavior are not proven. D35/T36 keep this as a hardening observation, not a vulnerability candidate.

references.claim: privileged local Binder gate and listener/index/reply/auth ordering

transaction_path_findings.existing_tests_and_counterexamples: D35/T36 identify SendRequestTest005 (empty parcel), Test006 (UID 10000 rejected), and Test017 (mock UID 9999 boundary); direct fuzzer does not establish a real Binder or network caller. D35/T36 found no unbounded repeat index growth for the same stub. No tests were run by D43.

transaction_path_findings.path: GET_SESSION_NAME grant and reply failure / repeated grants
transaction_path_findings.caller_gate: GET_SESSION_NAME requires local Binder transport. The helper calls the receiver service's GetSessionName, which makes a nested SAMGR request. GET_GRANTED_SESSION_NAME also checks receiver-side SAMGR process state, not caller identity; the target transaction caller identity is used to construct the uid_pid name.
transaction_path_findings.state_effect: CreateSessionName performs DBinderGrantPermission before reply serialization. Thus a subsequent reply write failure has no local compensating removal. Repeated exported GetSessionName calls can increment the same name's IPC-side reference count without one-for-one demonstrated shutdown removes.
transaction_path_findings.error_and_rollback: D39/T40 confirmed this only as a conditional lifecycle/refcount possibility. The self-identity target is the service's own uid_pid; no cross-principal authorization, material impact, standard third-party package reachability, or target-paired backend semantics are proven. Do not infer backend slot exhaustion or permission behavior from unpaired SoftBus code.

transaction_path_findings.existing_tests_and_counterexamples: D39/T40 independently retain 0 candidates and at most one conditional observation. D39 notes shutdown removal is once per relevant callback, but one query is not shown to create a distinct session/socket; backend and product policy remain unknown. No tests were run by D43.

transaction_path_findings.caller_gate: ADD_COMMAUTH rejects local Binder and requires DBinder caller UID < 10000; databus dispatch is preceded by CheckAndSetCallerInfo. GET_SESSION_NAME_FOR_PID_UID, GET_PID_UID and REMOVE_SESSION_NAME require local Binder plus receiver IsSamgrCall; CLEAR_SERVICE_STATE is a no-op.
transaction_path_findings.state_effect: ADD_COMMAUTH reads peer identity fields and may attach/update map/auth state; malformed device ID, missing process skeleton, and unresolved stub index return before attachment. Other inspected query handlers either write replies or grant as described above; no extra partial state/cleanup path was found.

transaction_path_findings.existing_tests_and_counterexamples: D25/T26/T27/T28 previously found no ordinary-app authorization/effect path for ADD_COMMAUTH; D35/T36 cover listener setup; D37/T38 cover session and PID/UID query routes. No new candidate in this adjacent scan.

observations_retained_for_l2_or_followup.claim: Pass-gate INCREFS may reinsert a socket relation after concurrent close cleanup; schedule, attacker control and material impact remain unproven.
INVOKE_LISTEN_THREAD leaves listener/index state without immediate rollback on late setup/reply failure; ordinary reachability and harmful persistence remain unproven.
Repeated GET_SESSION_NAME or post-grant reply failure may leave same-name IPC grant refcount unmatched; caller-self scope, product reachability and material impact remain unproven.

candidate_assessment.verdict: No high-confidence candidate found. Preserve the three bounded lifecycle observations as existing cross-task questions, not as new findings from D43.
